text: dsh-rtl 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的聊天界面排版插件，为波斯语和阿拉伯语对话提供从右向左的阅读和输入体验。它作为客户端模块向页面添加一段限定在聊天记录与输入区的样式，并在模块释放时清理样式。插件会将消息正文、用户气泡和输入框设为 RTL，镜像列表缩进，同时让代码、数学公式等技术内容继续保持 LTR 并隔离双向文本。适合使用波斯语或阿拉伯语交流、但希望代码和标点仍按通常方向显示的 DSH 用户。样式仅作用于聊天区域，不改变侧栏和工具栏；无需 API 密钥或额外服务。

dsh-rtl adapts DeepSeek Harness Web chat for Persian and Arabic. It adds a scoped stylesheet that right-aligns messages and the composer, mirrors list indentation, and keeps code and math left-to-right. It leaves surrounding tools unchanged and needs no API key.

阿拉伯语消息显示方向不对，有办法调整吗？
让 DSH 的聊天输入框支持从右向左书写。
RTL 对话里代码块还是要按从左到右阅读。
聊天消息中的列表缩进想移到右侧。
Can I read Arabic chat messages right-to-left in the web client?
Keep code snippets left-to-right while writing Persian in chat.
Align the conversation transcript and composer for RTL languages.
dsh-rtl 的功能「聊天消息 RTL」：将限定区域内的 Markdown 正文与消息气泡设为从右向左并右对齐。启用客户端模块后自动生效。
dsh-rtl 的功能「镜像列表」：把聊天正文中有序和无序列表的缩进从左侧调整到右侧，使列表标记位于 RTL 文本一侧。
dsh-rtl 的功能「技术文本保持 LTR」：代码、键盘文本和 KaTeX 内容继续从左向右显示，并隔离双向文本以保持标点顺序。
dsh-rtl 的功能「RTL 输入框」：把聊天编辑区和文本框设为从右向左并右对齐，方便直接输入波斯语或阿拉伯语。

@local/dsh-rtl README · dsh-rtl：Right-to-left, right-aligned text for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) chat —
built for Persian and Arabic conversations that the default LTR transcript renders badly.

[فارسی](README.fa.md) · English

A small DSH profile bundle: a Host half that does nothing, plus a Client module that
registers one stylesheet and removes it on dispose. No fork of the harness, no patched
artifacts, no DOM rewriting.

@local/dsh-rtl README · What it changes：| Surface | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Assistant messages (Markdown) | LTR, left-aligned | RTL, right-aligned |
| User message bubble | LTR, left-aligned | RTL, right-aligned |
| Lists inside messages | marker on the left, indent on the left | marker on the right, mirrored indent |
| Code blocks, inline code, KaTeX | LTR | LTR, and `unicode-bidi: isolate` so their punctuation cannot reorder the sentence |
| Composer | LTR | RTL while typing |

@local/dsh-rtl README · What it changes：The sidebar, tab strip, toolbars, and Settings keep their own direction; the stylesheet is
scoped to the transcript and the composer.
@local/dsh-rtl README · Install：The bundle is installed the same way as any other DSH plugin — no build step.

@local/dsh-rtl README · From a local checkout：1. **Plugins** → **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the absolute path of this directory.
3. Install, then switch **Right-to-left Chat** on.

Restart DeepSeek Harness if the manager reports `restart-required`.
@local/dsh-rtl README · Uninstall：**Plugins** → **Right-to-left Chat** → **Remove**.

@local/dsh-rtl README · Selectors：DSH class names are CSS-module hashes, so the stylesheet matches the stable parts instead:
the `data-slot="conversation.chat.flow"` transcript anchor, the `data-chat-turn` rows, the
`data-conversation-scroll` container, class names that contain `markdown` or `bubble`, and
`[data-composer-seat]` for the editor. If a future Harness release renames one of them, the
fix is a one-line selector change in `client.js`.

@local/dsh-rtl README · Compatibility：Written against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (Desktop and Web). It touches only presentation, so a
release that changes no chat DOM keeps working.

@local/dsh-rtl README · Connecting it to the Harness project：The harness repository ships **no** RTL or bidi handling of its own — this repository exists
to fill that gap. It follows the project's documented path for community plugins:

@local/dsh-rtl README · Connecting it to the Harness project：The upstream repository has issues and pull requests disabled, so this is distributed as a
standalone bundle rather than a patch to the harness sources. The same plugin is also staged
in the upstream package shape under [`upstream/`](upstream/README.md) — `packages/client/ui-rtl`
with the repository's TypeScript, tsconfig, and `?inline` CSS conventions — ready to apply if
that repository starts accepting contributions.
